items.title: 特區政府與亞投行簽署兩份協議 確立亞投行在港設辦事處
items.summary: 香港特區政府與亞洲基礎設施投資銀行簽署兩份協議，國家財政部部長藍佛安、亞投行副行長鄒嘉怡、中央政府駐港聯絡辦副主任張永，出席協議簽署儀式。 財政司司長陳茂波表示，剛簽署的協議包括正式確立亞投行在香港設立辦事處，充分展現亞投行對香港作為國際金融中心的堅定信心，香港亦能夠直接在多方面為亞投行工作作出貢獻。 他強調，香港資產管理規模逾5萬億美元，融資渠道完善，可提供相關專業知識，認為香港金融市場能夠為各方提供進入龐大國際資金池的途徑。…
items.titleEn: The regional government signed two agreements with AIB to set up an AIB office in the port.
items.summaryEn: The Hong Kong Regional Government and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank signed two agreements, with the Minister of State for Finance, Mr. Bluffan, Vice President of the Sub Investment Bank, Mr. Zhang Yong, Deputy Director of the Central Government's Liaison Office in Port of Hong Kong, attending the signing ceremony. According to Finance Department Director Chen Mabo, the agreement signed recently includes the formal establishment of the Hong Kong office of AIIB, full demonstration of AIIBI's firm confidence in Hong Kong as an international financial center, and the ability to contribute directly to its work in a number of ways. He stressed that Hong Kong's asset management of over $5 trillion, refined financing channels and expertise can provide relevant expertise, and believes that Hong Kong financial markets can provide access to the vast international pool of funds. items.title: 立法會堅決反對美中經濟與安全審議委員會所謂「2026年報告」
items.summary: 立法會表示，強烈不滿和堅決反對美中經濟與安全審議委員會發表所謂「2026年報告」，對香港情況作出失實、偏頗的陳述，肆意詆毀「一國兩制」，又對香港的司法獨立和法治、依法維護國家安全工作、選舉制度，以及經濟發展等多方面無理抹黑。立法會發言人表示強烈譴責，並堅定支持特區政府就該報告發出的聲明，直斥其非，以正視聽，維護香港聲譽。…
items.titleEn: The legislature is firmly opposed to the so-called "2026 Report" of the U.S.-China Economic and Security Council.
items.summaryEn: The legislature said it was strongly and firmly opposed to the so-called "2026 Report" issued by the U.S.-China Economic and Security Council, which made false, biased statements about the situation in Hong Kong, deliberately denounced the "one country, two systems", and violated Hong Kong's judicial independence and rule of law, as well as the legal protection of national security, electoral systems, and economic development. A spokesman for the Legislative Assembly strongly condemned and strongly supported the statement by the regional government on the report, denouncing its failure to listen carefully and defend Hong Kong's voice. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 丘應樺：大廈維修工程圍標問題嚴重 需立即針對性提出修例
items.summary: 政府計劃將樓宇維修圍標行為刑事化，大律師公會早前指，有必要釐清《競爭條例》下寬待機制會否在作出刑事檢控時依然生效；以及現時「吹哨者」向競委會舉報可獲豁免的做法，會否涵蓋至刑事檢控。商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺表示，不排除會加入相關考慮，但並非容易，需要視乎實際情況和律政司意見等不同因素。 丘應樺在一個電視節目說，現時刑事法例下，警方已有相關機制，調查過程亦可以透過其他方法搜集證據提出檢控，不一定要依靠「吹哨人」。…
items.titleEn: Chongqing: The problem of building repair is serious and there is an immediate need for sexual remedies
items.summaryEn: The government plans to criminalize building repair barriers, and the Advocate General's Council has already indicated that it is necessary to clarify whether the rules on competition will remain in force when criminal prosecutions are conducted; and whether the current "whistleblower" will report to the Competition Commission on exemptions that will cover criminal prosecution. The Director of the Office of Business and Economic Development, Choi Choi, said that the inclusion of relevant considerations is not excluded, but that it is not easy and that different factors such as the actual situation and the opinion of the Legal Department need to be taken into account. In a televised interview, he said that under current criminal law, the police have a mechanism that allows the investigation process to be conducted by other means of gathering evidence, rather than relying on "whistleblowers". items.summaryEn: In Brussels, Belgium, the Director of Finance and Treasury, Xu Jiaohu, completed his final leg of his visit to Europe on Friday (local time). Hu Jintao met Jan Jambon, Deputy Prime Minister of Belgium and Minister of Finance and Pensions, on Thursday, local time. He said Hong Kong is committed to building an ecosystem of gold and commodities with reliable capabilities for global market participants, such as financing, interconnection, price discovery, risk management, storage and insurance, thus opening up relevant global markets. items.title: 港鐵東涌綫延綫工序下周六晚進行 往來東涌站欣澳站列車提早完結
items.summary: 港鐵東涌綫延綫、東涌東段的第三次關鍵波口安裝工序，將於本月28日，即下周六深夜進行。 為騰出路軌集中完成相關工序，當晚往來東涌站及欣澳站的列車服務，將提早於晚上約11時完結，安排大致與早前兩次的安排相同。期間，港鐵將提供免費接駁巴士往來東涌站及欣澳站。往來香港站至欣澳站的列車服務維持正常。當晚車站將加派人手及增設指示，呼籲乘客留意尾班列車的開出時間，預早規劃行程。 港鐵又表示，會盡力確保工序順利完成，讓東涌綫翌日頭班車起恢復正常服務。…
items.titleEn: Port Rail's eastbound and eastbound trains are scheduled for late Saturday night, with the arrival and departure of the train at Himachal Pradesh station completed early
items.summaryEn: The third key port installation process for the East-West section of the Port Railways will take place late next Saturday, 28th of this month. The train service to and from the East Stream station and Himachal Pradesh station will be completed at around 11 p.m. and will be approximately the same as the two previous schedules. During this period, Port Railways will provide free buses to and from the East Stream station and Himachal Pradesh station. The train service from Hong Kong to Himachal Pradesh station is maintained as normal. In the evening, the train station will add a handshake and additional instructions, urging passengers to pay attention to the timing of the departure of the final train and to plan their journey ahead of time. Port Rail said it would do its best to ensure the process was completed and that the first train would return to normal service the next day. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: Sports Dispute Resolution Summit to discuss the latest trends in international sports arbitration
items.summaryEn: The Hong Kong Bar Association, the Hong Kong Bar Council and the Hong Kong Department of Law are now accepting free registration at the Sports Dispute Resolution Summit, which will take place on 1st July. The summit will feature two thematic seminars, which will explore in depth the latest trends and future developments in international sport mediation and arbitration. Zhang Chang, Deputy Head of the Legal Department and Chairman of the Advisory Committee for the Settlement of Sports Disputes, said that the Legal Department has been working with the Hong Kong sports and legal community on an ongoing basis and actively promoting cooperation with international and regional sports organizations in order to promote the international reach of Hong Kong's sports dispute settlement services.
